master.definition_en: Nephrocalcinosis is a disorder that occurs when too much calcium is deposited in the kidneys. It commonly occurs in premature infants. Individuals may not have symptoms or may have symptoms related to thecondition causing nephrocalcinosis. If kidney stones are present, symptoms may include blood in the urine, fever and chills, nausea and vomiting, and severe pain in the belly area, sides of the back (flank), groin, or testicles. Later symptoms may be associated with chronic kidney failure. It may be caused by use of certain medications or supplements, infection, or any condition that leads to high levels of calcium in the blood or urine including hyperparathyroidism, renal tubular acidosis, Alport syndrome, Bartter syndrome,and a variety of other conditions. Some of the underlying disorders that can cause nephrocalcinosis are genetic, with the inheritance pattern depending on the specific disorder. Treatment differs depending on the cause of nephrocalcinosis and often aims to prevent more calcium from being deposited in the kidneys.

master.name_zh: 肺结核（含耐多药肺结核 MDR-TB）
master.definition_en: A bacterial infection that affects the lungs and is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Most patients with tuberculosis do not have symptoms (latent tuberculosis) and are not contagious. When signs and symptoms occur (active tuberculosis), patients become contagious. The signs and symptoms include chronic cough with blood-tinged sputum, night sweats, fever, fatigue, and weight loss.

curated.name_zh: 肺结核（含耐多药肺结核 MDR-TB）
aliases_zh: 耐多药/利福平耐药肺结核 (MDR/RR-TB)
curated.category: 重大传染病 (Major Notifiable Infectious Disease)
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 由结核分枝杆菌经空气飞沫传播引起慢性破坏性肺部传染病，但重症粟粒性肺结核、结核性脑膜炎或突发大咯血可在数日至数周内致死；未规律治疗病例5年病死率可达50%以上，仍高居全球单一传染病原死因首位。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 药物敏感肺结核经6个月规范联合化疗治愈率超过85%–90%；既往疗程长达18–24个月且毒性大的耐多药肺结核（MDR/RR-TB），现已进入“全口服短程6个月BPaL/BPaLM时代”，治愈率显著跃升至约85%–90%。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO 2025年结核病实况统计2025年全球约1,060万人新发结核病、113万人死于结核病（含13.7万名HIV合并感染者）；此前2024年全球报告为2023年约1,080万发病例、125万死亡、40万例MDR/RR-TB。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: WHO全球结核病报告估算中国2023年结核病死亡约27,000例、新发估算约74.1万例（含约2.9万例MDR/RR-TB）；2024年中国法定传染病被动监测直接登记肺结核569,081例、死亡1,989例。
annual_deaths_china.source: WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2024 / 国家疾控局

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球每年新发逾千万例且约四分之一世界人口处于结核潜伏感染状态，MDR/RR-TB治疗覆盖与高额费用仍为全球防控瓶颈。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国属于全球30个结核病及MDR/RR-TB高负担国家之一，耐多药率与老年内源性复燃病例负担仍十分突出。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 遇突发大咯血（单次≥100 mL或24小时≥500 mL）即刻患侧卧位防血块阻塞健侧支气管窒息、保持气道通畅、静脉予垂体后叶素止血（无高血压禁忌时），内科无效急诊行支气管动脉栓塞术（BAE）；疑诊粟粒性肺结核并发ARDS或结核性脑膜炎尽早联合全身糖皮质激素与强效抗结核；疑似患者同步快速Xpert MTB/RIF分子耐药检测避免单药加药导致耐药放大。

master.definition_en: Microcephaly-cerebellar hypoplasia-cardiac conduction defect syndrome is a rare, genetic congenital anomalies/dysmorphic syndrome characterized by growth failure, global developmental delay, profound intellectual disability, autistic behaviors, acquired second-degree heart block with bradycardia and vasomotor instability. master.definition_en: Criss cross heart (CCH) is a cardiac malformation where the inflow streams of the two ventricles cross due to twisting of the heart about its major axis. master.definition_en: Hemophagocytic syndrome (HPS) is a rare immune disease and a potentially life-threatening disorder characterized by cytokine storm and overwhelming inflammation causing fever, hepatosplenomegaly, cytopenia, hypertriglyceridemia, hyperferritinemia, and hemophagocytosis in bone marrow, liver, spleen or lymph nodes. It can be either primary due to a genetic defect (primary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis), or secondary to malignancies, to infections, most commonly with viruses such as Epstein-Barr virus or cytomegalovirus, human immunodeficiency virus, or to autoimmune disorders such as systemic lupus erythematosus or adult-onset Still disease (secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis).

master.definition_en: A rare disorder due to poisoning characterized by variable combination and dose-dependent severity of clinical manifestations, affecting behavior, central nervous and cardiovascular system. Patients present with euphoria, irritability, agitation, psychosis, hallucinations, paranoia, seizures, decreased responsiveness, mydriasis, tachyarrhythmia, chest pain, and cardiovascular collapse. Sometimes also dyspnea, hypertension, hyperthermia, hypothermia, lack of sleep and serotonin syndrome are present. Severe intoxication may lead to coma and death.

master.definition_en: A rare congenital non-syndromic heart malformation characterized by an abnormal protrusion of the interatrial septum into the right or left atrium, or both, during the cardiorespiratory cycle. The defect may be limited to the fossa ovalis or involve the entire septum. It can present as an isolated finding but is more often associated with interatrial shunts, in particular patent foramen ovale. Clinically it increases the risk of peripheral arterial embolism and stroke.

master.definition_en: An acute hypersensitivity reaction that occurs from exposure to an allergen. It results from the release of histamine and histamine-like substances from mast cells, and can present with breathing difficulty due to narrowed airways, dizziness and hypotension, skin rash, weak pulse, nausea and vomiting.

mechanisms: Ig epsilon chain C region inhibitor

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 人体最快的急性免疫血管灾难之一：药物（如β内酰胺类抗生素、造影剂）、食物（花生/海鲜/牛奶）或蜂蛰毒素触发IgE介导肥大细胞与嗜碱粒细胞瞬间脱颗粒，释放大量组胺与血管活性介质，可在数分钟至半小时内引发致命性喉头水肿窒息、重度支气管痉挛与毛细血管通透性激增所致分布性休克及心脏骤停。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 若在数分钟内立即大腿外侧肌注肾上腺素（而非先用抗组胺药或激素拖延），绝大多数患者可完全迅速逆转并痊愈、不留后遗症；致死悲剧主要源于院外缺乏预充式肾上腺素自动注射笔（如EpiPen/Jext）或院内给药延误。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 唯一一线救命处置——即刻大腿中段前外侧肌内注射1:1000（1mg/ml）肾上腺素（成人0.3–0.5mg，儿童0.01mg/kg，每5–15分钟可重复）！严禁以地塞米松或异丙嗪替代或延误肾上腺素肌注；同时平卧抬高下肢（呼吸困难可半卧）、高流量吸氧、快速静脉输注生理盐水扩容；难治性低血压立即静脉滴注肾上腺素；出现重度喉头水肿窒息立即气管插管或环甲膜切开；抗组胺药与糖皮质激素仅作二线辅助（防双相延迟反应，观察至少6–24小时）。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 国际及国内可及性正在改善：1）非注射式鼻喷雾剂型肾上腺素（Neffy，2024年获FDA/EMA批准）大幅降低患者对针头恐惧，开启无针急救新时代；2）奥马珠单抗（抗IgE单抗，Omalizumab）在OUtMATCH 3期试验中获批用于降低多种食物过敏患者意外误食诱发的严重过敏反应风险；3）中国通过粤港澳大湾区‘港澳药械通’政策引进了国内首款肾上腺素预充笔Jext落地临床急需使用，打破内地长期有安瓿瓶无便携自救笔的空白。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1）肾上腺素自动注射笔尚未在中国内地全面普及上市及纳入常规药品保障，导致院外食物/蜂毒高危患者随身抢救工具极度匮乏；2）部分基层诊所仍误将地塞米松/异丙嗪作为首选而延误肾上腺素肌注；3）双相延迟反应缺乏准确早期预测生物标志物。

master.definition_en: A group of rare central nervous system malformations characterized by varying degrees of absence or dysplasia of the derivatives of the prosencephalon (i.e. telencephalon and diencephalon), with an intact cranial vault. The spectrum comprises atelencephaly, the less severe form, in which only the telencephalon is affected, and aprosencephaly, where the diencephalon is also involved. The malformations may occur in an isolated form or in association with other anomalies.
